title: Quarterly and unit tests
subtitle: Build tests from textbook topics with AI, review them and run them online.
empty: Create your first CHSB or BSB test — AI drafts questions from the textbook topics.
reviewHint: Review the AI-drafted questions: fix or delete anything wrong or unclear, then publish.

typeHints.CHSB: Covers topics taught during the quarter.
typeHints.BSB: Covers the topics of one unit (chapter).

create.title: New AI test
create.description: Choose the subject and class, test type and topics. Questions are drafted from the textbook pages.
create.topics: Topics (those taught this quarter are marked)
create.noTopics: There are no approved textbook topics for this subject and grade. An administrator must upload the textbook and approve its topics.
create.noGrade: The class grade is not set — contact the administrator.
create.aiNote: Questions are drafted by AI from the textbook. Review every question before publishing — students cannot see the test until you publish it.

generating.title: AI is building the test…
generating.hint: Usually takes 20–60 seconds. You can close this page; it keeps going.

actions.confirmRegenerate: Current questions will be deleted and AI will draft new ones. Continue?
actions.confirmClose: The test will close: students who haven't started can't take it, started attempts are graded with saved answers.
actions.confirmDelete: The test will be permanently deleted. Continue?

publish.title: Publish to students
publish.hint: Students start the test within this window; once started they get {{minutes}} minutes (never past the window end).

results.byQuestionHint: A low percentage means the class hasn't mastered the topic — or the question is unclear.
